name: page-header
title: Page Header
description: Presentational page header: an eyebrow, a title at the heading level you choose, a description, an actions slot that wraps below the title on narrow screens, a breadcrumb slot and a tabs slot.
docs: The title is an `h1` by default (`headingLevel` changes it) with a generated id, or `titleId`, for `aria-labelledby`. `eyebrow` is a small uppercase kicker above it. `tabs` takes a `TabsList` under the title row: wrap the page in `Tabs` so the list and its `TabsPanel`s share a root, and name the list with `aria-label`.
